aboutText: Green Planet Gardening has been serving Newport and Melbourne's west with top-quality lawn care and gardening services. We specialise in transforming outdoor spaces into neat, manicured gardens, offering everything from regular maintenance to complete garden clean-ups. Our team takes pride in delivering the highest quality service to every client. Contact us for a free quote today.
servicesText: At Green Planet Gardening, we provide a wide range of services to keep your garden looking its best. From routine mowing to specialised hedge trimming, our team is equipped to handle all your gardening needs efficiently and professionally.
